# RESTORE.md: rebuild Eric's Mac agent setup

Use this on a new, wiped or replaced Mac. Mac only. Checked against the live Mac 2026-10-24.
Read it anywhere: `github.com/erash11/dotclaude/blob/main/RESTORE.md` (sign in as erash11), or Drive `_MACHINE/Backups/RESTORE.md` (each backup run refreshes it).

## 1. What lives where

| What | True copy | Backup |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.claude` settings, hooks, scripts, agents, session transcripts | GitHub `dotclaude` | CRASHBOX `claude/`; Drive `claude-projects.tgz` |
| Skills / working memory | GitHub `claude-skills` / `claude-global-memory` | CRASHBOX `claude/skills`, `claude/global-memory` |
| Memory compiler | GitHub `claude-memory-compiler` (code only) | CRASHBOX `claude/claude-memory-compiler`: the ONLY copy of `daily/`, `knowledge/`, `reports/` |
| DEV router files / projects | GitHub `DEV` / `erash11/<folder>` | Drive `_MACHINE/Cloud_Copy/DEV` (no DBs, no secrets) |
| DEV gitignored data, uncommitted edits | local | CRASHBOX `DEV-repo-data/`, `DEV-working-tree/`, `DEV-nonrepo/` |
| DEV databases (DuckDB, SQLite) | local | Drive `dev-databases.tgz` |
| SecondBrain vault | GitHub `SecondBrain` | CRASHBOX `SecondBrain/` |
| Codex, Gemini, launchd jobs | local | Drive tgz files; CRASHBOX `codex/`, `gemini/`, `LaunchAgents/` |
| Zotero library | `~/Zotero` | Drive `zotero.tgz` (at most weekly) |
| Documents | Drive `00_Primary_Storage_Drive/` | Google |
| Secrets | macOS Keychain, local `.env` | password manager only |

Rules for every kind of file: `~/.claude/STORAGE.md`.

## 2. Accounts you need first

- GitHub `erash11`: every repo. Google (personal gmail): Drive backups. claude.ai: Claude Code sign-in.
- Also sign in again to OpenAI (Codex), Gemini, Fireflies, Zotero, VALD, Catapult and the claude.ai connectors.
- Get every password and 2FA code from the password manager. No backup holds a credential.

## 3. Clone the config repos

```bash
gh auth login                            # account erash11
curl -sI https://github.com | head -1    # must answer before you clone
mkdir -p ~/.claude && cd ~/.claude
git init -b main && git remote add origin https://github.com/erash11/dotclaude.git
git fetch origin && git checkout -f origin/main -b main    # -f replaces fresh-install files
[ -e ~/.claude/skills ] && mv ~/.claude/skills ~/.claude/skills.fresh-install
git clone https://github.com/erash11/claude-skills.git ~/.claude/skills
git clone https://github.com/erash11/claude-global-memory.git ~/.claude/global-memory
git clone https://github.com/erash11/claude-memory-compiler.git ~/.claude/claude-memory-compiler
git clone https://github.com/erash11/DEV.git ~/DEV
git clone https://github.com/erash11/SecondBrain.git ~/SecondBrain    # backup syncs this exact path
cp ~/.claude/machine.macos.md ~/.claude/machine.md
for p in ~/.claude ~/.claude/skills ~/.claude/global-memory ~/.claude/claude-memory-compiler ~/DEV ~/SecondBrain; do git -C "$p" remote get-url origin; done
```

- Expect six `https://github.com/erash11/...` URLs. Expect `ls ~/.claude/skills | wc -l` near 65.
- Never remove the `/*` line at the top of `~/DEV/.gitignore`. It keeps the thin repo out of the project repos.
- List project repos: `gh repo list erash11 --no-archived --limit 300`. Clone each into `~/DEV/<repo>`.
- `Football` is also a thin repo. Clone it, then clone its 16 nested repos inside it. `LibraryProject` holds 1.
- The area index (`~/DEV/FOOTBALL.md`, `PERFORMANCE.md`, ...) names each nested folder. `Website` clones from `erash11/AppliedPerformance-Site`.
- Never clone or copy `DexaProject` to a cloud. It has no repo and holds health data.

## 4. Pull the machine backups from Drive

First route (gws is not signed in on a fresh Mac):
1. Open drive.google.com. Go to My Drive > `_MACHINE` > `Backups` > `Machine`.
2. Download one file at a time. Drive zips a multi-file download.
3. Extract after section 3. Extract `dev-databases.tgz` after the project repos are cloned.

```bash
cd ~/Downloads && mkdir -p ~/.codex
tar -xzf claude-projects.tgz -C ~/.claude       # -> ~/.claude/projects
tar -xzf codex-sessions.tgz -C ~/.codex; tar -xzf codex-agents.tgz -C ~/.codex; tar -xzf codex-sqlite.tgz -C ~/.codex
tar -xzf gemini.tgz -C ~                         # -> ~/.gemini (OAuth files left out: sign in again)
tar -xzf launchagents.tgz -C ~/Library           # -> ~/Library/LaunchAgents (load in section 7)
tar -xzf dev-databases.tgz --strip-components 1 -C ~/DEV   # live DBs back into their repos
tar -xzf zotero.tgz -C ~                         # -> ~/Zotero; quit Zotero first
```

- Each tgz is one copy, replaced on each run. There is no history. Receipts: `Machine/_receipts/run-<id>.txt`.
- `codex-memories.tgz` can be old or absent: its source folder no longer exists.
- DEV files not on GitHub: copy the folders you need from `_MACHINE/Cloud_Copy/DEV` in the Drive app.

Second route, after `npm install -g @googleworkspace/cli` and `gws auth login -s drive` (run from `~/Downloads`; gws writes `--output` only inside the current folder):

```bash
gws drive files list --params "{\"q\":\"'1ALag3z9Ew5ihBZKjt_1yZzsNpX-K4UJn' in parents and trashed = false\",\"fields\":\"files(id,name,size,modifiedTime)\"}"
gws drive files get --params '{"fileId":"<id>","alt":"media"}' --output ./<name>.tgz
```

If login asks for an OAuth client, put its JSON at `~/.config/gws/client_secret.json`, or run `gws auth setup` (needs the `gcloud-cli` cask).

## 5. CRASHBOX SSD

- Path `/Volumes/CRASHBOX/AssistantBackup` (500 GB, exFAT). It gets the second daily copy when plugged in at midday. It is additive: it never deletes.
- Holds: `claude/{agents,claude-memory-compiler,global-memory,hooks,projects,scripts,skills}`, `codex/` (no `work/`), `gemini/`, `LaunchAgents/`, `SecondBrain/` (no `.git`), `DEV-repo-data/<repo>/`, `DEV-working-tree/<repo>/`, `DEV-nonrepo/<folder>/`, `DexaProject/`, `_receipts/`.
- `DexaProject/` is identifiable health data. Keep it on local disk only. Never paste it anywhere.
- Clone first. Then overlay:


1	# RESTORE.md: rebuild Eric's Mac agent setup
2	Use this on a new, wiped or replaced Mac. Mac only. Checked against the live Mac 2026-10-24.
3	Read it anywhere: `github.com/erash11/dotclaude/blob/main/RESTORE.md` (sign in as erash11), or Drive `_MACHINE/Backups/RESTORE.md` (each backup run refreshes it).
4	
5	## 1. What lives where (rules for every kind of file: `~/.claude/STORAGE.md`)
6	| What | True copy | Backup |
7	|---|---|---|
8	| `~/.claude` settings, hooks, scripts, agents, session transcripts | GitHub `dotclaude` | CRASHBOX `claude/`; Drive `claude-projects.tgz` |
9	| Skills / working memory | GitHub `claude-skills` / `claude-global-memory` | CRASHBOX `claude/skills`, `claude/global-memory` |
10	| Memory compiler | GitHub `claude-memory-compiler` (code only) | CRASHBOX `claude/claude-memory-compiler`: the ONLY copy of `daily/`, `knowledge/`, `reports/` |
11	| DEV router files / projects | GitHub `DEV` / `erash11/<folder>` | Drive `_MACHINE/Cloud_Copy/DEV` (no DBs, no secrets) |
12	| DEV gitignored data, uncommitted edits, databases | local | CRASHBOX `DEV-repo-data/`, `DEV-working-tree/`, `DEV-nonrepo/`; DBs also Drive `dev-databases.tgz` |
13	| SecondBrain vault | GitHub `SecondBrain` | CRASHBOX `SecondBrain/` |
14	| Codex, Gemini, launchd jobs, Zotero | local (`~/Zotero` for Zotero) | Drive tgz files (Zotero at most weekly); CRASHBOX `codex/`, `gemini/`, `LaunchAgents/` |
15	| Documents | Drive `00_Primary_Storage_Drive/` | Google |
16	| Secrets | macOS Keychain, local `.env` | password manager only |
17	
18	## 2. Accounts you need first
19	- GitHub `erash11`: every repo. Google (personal gmail): Drive backups. claude.ai: Claude Code sign-in. Then sign in again to OpenAI (Codex), Gemini, Fireflies, Zotero, VALD, Catapult and the claude.ai connectors.
20	- Get every password and 2FA code from the password manager. No backup holds a credential.
21	
22	## 3. Clone the config repos
23	```bash
24	gh auth login && curl -sI https://github.com | head -1   # account erash11; curl must answer before you clone
25	mkdir -p ~/.claude && cd ~/.claude && git init -b main
26	git remote add origin https://github.com/erash11/dotclaude.git && git fetch origin
27	git checkout -f origin/main -b main                       # -f replaces fresh-install files
28	[ -e ~/.claude/skills ] && mv ~/.claude/skills ~/.claude/skills.fresh-install
29	git clone https://github.com/erash11/claude-skills.git ~/.claude/skills
30	git clone https://github.com/erash11/claude-global-memory.git ~/.claude/global-memory
31	git clone https://github.com/erash11/claude-memory-compiler.git ~/.claude/claude-memory-compiler
32	git clone https://github.com/erash11/DEV.git ~/DEV
33	git clone https://github.com/erash11/SecondBrain.git ~/SecondBrain    # backup syncs this exact path
34	cp ~/.claude/machine.macos.md ~/.claude/machine.md
35	for p in ~/.claude ~/.claude/skills ~/.claude/global-memory ~/.claude/claude-memory-compiler ~/DEV ~/SecondBrain; do git -C "$p" remote get-url origin; done
36	```
37	- Expect six `https://github.com/erash11/...` URLs, and `ls ~/.claude/skills | wc -l` near 65.
38	- Never remove the `/*` line at the top of `~/DEV/.gitignore`. It keeps the thin repo out of the project repos.
39	- List project repos: `gh repo list erash11 --no-archived --limit 300`. Clone each into `~/DEV/<repo>`. `Website` clones from `erash11/AppliedPerformance-Site`.
40	- `Football` is also a thin repo: clone it, then its 16 nested repos inside it. `LibraryProject` holds 1. The area index (`~/DEV/FOOTBALL.md`, ...) names each folder. `DexaProject` has no repo and holds health data: never put it on a cloud.
41	
42	## 4. Pull the machine backups from Drive
43	First route (gws is not signed in on a fresh Mac): open drive.google.com > My Drive > `_MACHINE` > `Backups` > `Machine`. Download one file at a time (Drive zips a multi-file download).
44	```bash
45	cd ~/Downloads && mkdir -p ~/.codex && tar -xzf claude-projects.tgz -C ~/.claude    # -> ~/.claude/projects
46	tar -xzf codex-sessions.tgz -C ~/.codex; tar -xzf codex-agents.tgz -C ~/.codex; tar -xzf codex-sqlite.tgz -C ~/.codex
47	tar -xzf gemini.tgz -C ~                         # -> ~/.gemini (OAuth files left out: sign in again)
48	tar -xzf launchagents.tgz -C ~/Library           # -> ~/Library/LaunchAgents (load in section 7)
49	tar -xzf dev-databases.tgz --strip-components 1 -C ~/DEV   # after the project clones: live DBs into their repos
50	tar -xzf zotero.tgz -C ~                         # -> ~/Zotero; quit Zotero first
51	```
52	- Each tgz is one copy, replaced on each run, with no history. `codex-memories.tgz` can be old or absent: its source folder no longer exists. Receipts: `Machine/_receipts/run-<id>.txt`. DEV files not on GitHub: copy the folders you need from `_MACHINE/Cloud_Copy/DEV` in the Drive app.
53	
54	Second route, once gws signs in. Run from `~/Downloads`: gws writes `--output` only inside the current folder.
55	```bash
56	npm install -g @googleworkspace/cli && gws auth login -s drive   # no OAuth client? save it as ~/.config/gws/client_secret.json, or run gws auth setup (needs gcloud-cli)
57	gws drive files list --params "{\"q\":\"'1ALag3z9Ew5ihBZKjt_1yZzsNpX-K4UJn' in parents and trashed = false\",\"fields\":\"files(id,name,size,modifiedTime)\"}"
58	gws drive files get --params '{"fileId":"<id>","alt":"media"}' --output ./<name>.tgz
59	```
60	
61	## 5. CRASHBOX SSD
62	- Path `/Volumes/CRASHBOX/AssistantBackup` (500 GB, exFAT). It gets the second daily copy when plugged in at midday. It is additive: it never deletes.
63	- Holds `claude/{agents,claude-memory-compiler,global-memory,hooks,projects,scripts,skills}`, `codex/` (no `work/`), `gemini/`, `LaunchAgents/`, `SecondBrain/` (no `.git`), `DEV-repo-data/<repo>/`, `DEV-working-tree/<repo>/`, `DEV-nonrepo/<folder>/`, `_receipts/`, and `DexaProject/` (identifiable health data: keep it on local disk only, never paste it anywhere).
64	- Clone first. Then overlay:
65	```bash
66	SSD=/Volumes/CRASHBOX/AssistantBackup
67	rsync -a "$SSD/DEV-repo-data/" ~/DEV/ && rsync -a "$SSD/DEV-working-tree/" ~/DEV/
68	for d in daily knowledge reports; do rsync -a "$SSD/claude/claude-memory-compiler/$d/" ~/.claude/claude-memory-compiler/$d/; done
69	```
70	- Copy a `DEV-nonrepo/<folder>` only when GitHub has no repo for it: its copy can hold an older `.git`. In each repo that took CRASHBOX files, run `git config core.fileMode false` (exFAT sets every file to mode 755).
71	
72	## 6. Secrets
73	- The Keychain does not come back from any backup. Enter each value again from the password manager. Project `.env` key names and where to reissue each: `~/.claude/CREDENTIALS.md`.
74	- Items (names only): `FIREFLIES_API_KEY` (read by `~/.zshrc`), `typesafe-api-key` (read by `~/.zshenv` into `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`), `Claude Code-credentials` (Claude Code writes it at sign-in; do not add it).
75	- Add: `security add-generic-password -U -s FIREFLIES_API_KEY -a "$USER" -w` (a final `-w` prompts, so the value stays out of shell history). Check: the same name with `security find-generic-password -s FIREFLIES_API_KEY -a "$USER"` (no `-w`: prints the item, not the value).
76	
77	## 7. Tooling
78	```bash
79	/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)" && eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
80	brew install gh git go node powershell/tap/powershell ripgrep tmux rclone yt-dlp ocrmypdf poppler pipx r ghidra
81	brew install --cask google-drive gcloud-cli
82	npm install -g @openai/codex @googleworkspace/cli
83	curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh          # uv -> ~/.local/bin/uv, NOT Homebrew
84	curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash            # claude -> ~/.local/bin/claude, NOT npm
85	uv tool install 'memsearch[onnx]' && memsearch config set embedding.provider onnx
86	cd ~/.claude/claude-memory-compiler && uv sync
87	bash ~/.claude/skills/sync-to-codex.sh                   # rebuilds ~/.codex/skills and ~/.agents/skills
88	ln -s ~/.claude/AGENTS.md ~/.codex/AGENTS.md && ln -s ~/DEV/CLI_Dev/printing-press ~/printing-press
89	ln -s "$HOME/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-eric.rash11@gmail.com/My Drive/00_Primary_Storage_Drive" ~/DEV/_DRIVE
90	```
91	- Homebrew Python 3.14 is PEP 668-managed. Never `pip install` globally. Use a venv or `uv`. Go CLIs: `go install <module>@latest`, into `~/go/bin`. Each module path is in `~/.claude/skills/pp-*/SKILL.md`.
92	- Never run `memsearch index` by hand. It deletes every source outside the paths you give. The next daily backup rebuilds the index.
93	- Load the launchd jobs. launchd does not expand `~` or `$HOME`. If the account is not `kristinarash`, fix the paths in each plist first.
94	```bash
95	grep -l /Users/kristinarash ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.keystone.*.plist
96	for f in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.keystone.*.plist; do
97	  [ "$(basename "$f")" = com.keystone.rituals.plist ] && continue   # off on purpose since 2026-09-24
98	  launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) "$f"
99	done
100	launchctl disable gui/$(id -u)/com.keystone.rituals
101	launchctl list | grep -c 'com\.keystone\.'      # expect 15; com.google.keystone.* is Google Updater, not ours
102	```
103	- Give Terminal Full Disk Access: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access > Terminal. `com.keystone.clouddrivepush` opens `cloud-push.command` in Terminal, because a job started by launchd cannot list Drive folders. Full Disk Access on Python.app or rsync does not help.
104	- The daily backup runs only on AC power, hourly 12:00-17:00 and at login. The first run is slow. Verify: `pwsh -NoProfile -File ~/.claude/skills/claude-stack-doctor/scripts/stack-check.ps1` must print `ALL CLEAR`.
105	
106	## 8. Lessons from the 2026-08-05 restore that still apply
107	- DEV lives at `~/DEV`, not `~/Desktop/DEV`. A clone into a folder that already exists fails, and nothing reports it: move the old folder aside first.
108	- To repair a folder that already holds overlay files: `git init -b main`, `git remote add origin <url>`, `git fetch origin`, `git reset --mixed origin/main`, then `git ls-files -z --deleted | xargs -0 git checkout --`. This keeps the overlay edits.
109	- A plist that calls pwsh, git or uv directly needs an `EnvironmentVariables` PATH with `/opt/homebrew/bin`.
110	- Do not run `~/.claude/restore.command`: it targets the retired ASSISTANT stick and `~/Desktop/DEV`. Do not use `backup-manifest.json` as a repo list. Its `remote` and `isRepo` fields date from 2026-09-19.
111	
112	## 9. Deliberately NOT backed up
113	- `~/.codex/work` (disposable clones), caches, `.venv`, `node_modules`, tool binaries. The memsearch index `~/.memsearch/milvus.db` (the daily backup rebuilds it).
114	- All credentials: `.env` files, `.credentials.json`, OAuth tokens, `~/.config/gws`, Gemini `oauth_creds.json`, browser profiles.
115	- Known gaps (in no backup; rebuild by hand): `~/.zshrc`, `~/.zprofile`, `~/.zshenv` (brew shellenv, `~/.local/bin` and `~/go/bin` on PATH, the two Keychain exports), `~/.gitconfig`, `~/.claude.json` (the `zotero` MCP server), `~/.memsearch/config.toml`.
116	
117	## Keeping this document honest
118	When a backup, repo, store or scheduled job changes, update this file in the same session and commit it to dotclaude.
119
